name: Chimera (prompt to rig-ready skeletal animation)
summary: ComfyUI web app that turns a 3D model plus a short action prompt into editable skeletal animation: LTX-2.5 renders a motion video of the model, then Chimera fits the model's own rig to it and exports GLB, FBX and BVH (root-motion and in-place). Works on unanimated custom rigs; unrigged models can be rigged with SkinTokens. All inference is local on open weights.

access.notes: Code MIT. Required LTX-2.5 weights need a Hugging Face account and acceptance of Lightricks' access terms; model licenses apply to generated use. About 53 GB of model files; tested on RTX 5080 16 GB.

procedure: Follow SETUP.md to install ComfyUI and the custom nodes
Accept the LTX-2.5 terms on Hugging Face and download the five files listed in MODELS.md (~53 GB)
Upload a GLB or FBX, describe a move, click Animate, then download GLB/FBX/BVH

verdict.why: Real, documented pipeline with downloadable example GLB/FBX/BVH and an Unreal check; MIT code. Brand-new repo with no traction yet, heavy 16 GB VRAM / 53 GB weight requirement and LTX-2.5 gated terms.

image.alt: Turn a 3D model and a text prompt into editable skeletal animation with ComfyUI. - 0xC4LL3/chimera
